lines.cap: The richest man in history bought a king his crown. And then sent him the bill.
lines.say: The richest man in history bought a king his crown. And then sent him the bill.

lines.cap: Jakob Fugger. A banker from Augsburg, Germany, around 1500. Many historians call him the richest person who ever lived.
lines.say: Jakob Fugger. A banker from Augsburg, Germany, around 1500. Many historians call him the richest person who ever lived.

lines.cap: He lent money to the Habsburgs. In return, he got their silver and copper mines.
lines.say: He lent money to the Habsburgs. In return, he got their silver and copper mines.

lines.cap: In 1519, the job of Holy Roman Emperor was up for grabs. Chosen by seven electors. Who could be bribed.
lines.say: In 1519, the job of Holy Roman Emperor was up for grabs. Chosen by seven electors. Who could be bribed.

lines.cap: Fugger paid most of the bribes for his client, Charles of Habsburg. Around half a million florins. Charles won.
lines.say: Fugger paid most of the bribes for his client, Charles of Habsburg. Around half a million florins. Charles won.

lines.cap: Years later, Charles was slow to repay. So Fugger wrote to him. Without me, Your Majesty would not have the crown. Please pay.
lines.say: Years later, Charles was slow to repay. So Fugger wrote to him. Without me, Your Majesty would not have the crown. Please pay.

lines.cap: He also built the Fuggerei. Cheap housing for the poor. It still exists. The rent is still less than one euro a year.
lines.say: He also built the Fuggerei. Cheap housing for the poor. It still exists. The rent is still less than one euro a year.
